patterns: APPSC asks single facts: who was not a Gentlemen's Agreement signatory (Prakasam), name of the 1956 agreement, first CM (Sanjiva Reddy), first capital.
Visalandhra Mahasabha details recur: founded Nov 1949 at Vijayawada by Ayyadevara Kaleswara Rao, first meeting Warangal 1950; 'Communists opposed linguistic states' is the planted false statement.
CM chronology and tenure items are frequent (Sanjivayya 1960-62, Brahmananda Reddy 1964-71, Nadendla 31 days, Panchayat Raj under Sanjiva Reddy).
Telangana-movement leaders (TPS founder Chenna Reddy, CM during 1969 = Brahmananda Reddy, Ramananda Tirtha) are filed here too.
App adds dense statement sets on safeguard clauses, Hyderabad Congress resolution dates and 2026 Amaravati items far beyond PYQ depth, but they are factually sound.
